notes: A surface is a client through which a person reaches Agent OS.
Entries are provider-neutral descriptions only. Probing logic lives in src/agent_os/surfaces.py and path resolution in src/agent_os/machine.py.
Locations are machine-independent: '~' for the user home, '${VAR}' for an environment variable, 'repo/' for a path inside this repository.

surfaces.name: Claude Code
surfaces.summary: Terminal coding agent that calls Agent OS directly over MCP and is preflighted by the user-scoped instruction file.

inspect_local_config.reason: Agent OS can inspect the local MCP registration read-only.

mutate_local_config.reason: Connector adapters do not yet provision or edit this client's configuration.

transfer_credentials.reason: Credential values stay in approved local secret stores and are never copied between clients.

agent_os_bridge.reason: Direct MCP is supported when this client has an Agent OS registration.

surfaces.name: ChatGPT (regular chat)
surfaces.summary: No automatic invocation path. The routing skill is the thinnest bridge: the chat states its findings and they are captured locally through the CLI.

inspect_local_config.reason: Hosted chat connection settings are not visible to this local checkout.

mutate_local_config.reason: The host manages its own connector settings; Agent OS cannot edit them from this checkout.

transfer_credentials.reason: Agent OS has no supported API here to export hosted credentials into the local registry.

agent_os_bridge.reason: Availability depends on an Agent OS connection configured through the host.

invocation.reason: the host cannot start a local stdio server
